sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 233324 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: 2026 season Friday, May 22 - Sunday, October 25 ('Closed for Winter October 26-May 21'). The dates move each year (rec.gov's 2025 season opened June 13).

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/rocky-knob-cg.htm ('Friday, May 22, 2026 - Sunday, October 25, 2026', 'Closed for Winter October 26-May 21') read in headless Chromium (the page loads its hours by script), 2026-10-21

values.note: $30 per site per night; group camping $45 (12-20 people, no pass discount).

fees.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/rocky-knob-cg.htm ('Rocky Knob Campground Fee ... $30.00', 'Group Camping ... $45.00') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233324/rates (2026 Peak Season RV NONELECTRIC 30), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233324 (notice 'There are no showers. No electric, water, or sewer hook-ups are available.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 106 campsites (44 reservable, 62 first-come): 80 RV-capable standard/RV sites, 25 tent-only, one group tent area. Max vehicle lengths mostly 15-25 ft; nine sites take 55 ft and about 24 are pull-through. Most sites allow only one vehicle.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233324 ('In addition to the 44 sites available for advanced reservation, 62 campsites are available on a first-come, first-served basis') + recreation.gov campsite catalog (106 public sites; Max Vehicle Length up to 55; 24 Pull-through), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Flush toilets, dump station and drinking water are seasonal. Firewood sold seasonally; only certified heat-treated firewood may be brought in. No cell reception or internet.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/rocky-knob-cg.htm ('Laundry No', 'Dump Station Yes, Seasonal', 'Potable Water - Seasonal', 'Camp Store No', 'Flush Toilets - seasonal', 'Shower Types None') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233324 ('flush toilets, dump station, and drinking water', 'There are no showers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 44 sites reservable on recreation.gov; 62 are first-come, booked in person at the campground kiosk (open 9:30 AM-6 PM), status not shown online. 'The campground almost always has campsites available.' Reservations close 1 day before arrival; 30 days per year.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233324 (description; facility_rules reservationCutOff 1 'day(s) prior to arrival', maxConsecutiveStay 30, maxStay 30 days 'Each Year'; notice 'Some campsites at this facility are available on a first-come, first-served basis') + https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/rocky-knob-cg.htm (kiosk hours), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Holders of the Interagency Senior, Access, Golden Age, or Golden Access passes are entitled to a 50% discount on the base fee of the site physically occupied by the pass holder.' Not on group sites.

summary: Confirmed $30/night and no hookups (electric 0; water and sewer none too) on NPS and rec.gov. Added 2026 season May 22 - Oct 25, 106 sites to 55 ft with pull-throughs, flush toilets/dump/water, no showers/laundry/store, 44 reservable + 62 FCFS, 1-day cutoff, 30-night max, Senior/Access 50% off. Window left inherited.
